name: Node graph build
looks: Small labelled boxes connect one at a time: a line draws from an existing node out to a new one, the new node's box fades and scales in the instant the line lands, and the next connection starts right away, so a system diagram builds itself edge by edge until the whole graph sits connected.
build: Nodes at fixed, precomputed layout coordinates; each edge strokes on with strokeDashoffset (power2.out); the target node fades/scales in (0.9 -> 1) once its edge lands; one edge animates at a time in a seeded order.
sound: A soft tick per edge connecting, a slightly brighter tick when a node lands.
prompt: Build a small system diagram edge by edge: draw a line from an existing box out to a new one, let the new box fade and scale in the instant the line lands, and move straight to the next connection, until the whole diagram sits connected and readable.
